name: plugin.pr_lens_graph
description: PR Lens standalone animated SVG architecture diagrams, graph validation, and diff visualization
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: pr_lens_validate
entrypoints.description: Validate structural typing and cross-entity semantic integrity of a graph document

parameters.name: graph_doc
parameters.description: Graph document dictionary containing nodes, edges, lanes, and walkthrough

entrypoints.name: pr_lens_render
entrypoints.description: Render a validated graph document into a standalone animated SVG with inline keyframes

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Optional render configuration (width, height, theme, pulse_animation)

entrypoints.name: pr_lens_diff
entrypoints.description: Extract unified git diff between two commit references via safe subprocess transport

entrypoints.name: pr_lens_analyze
entrypoints.description: Synthesize a structured GraphDocument and progressive walkthrough from unified diff text

entrypoints.name: pr_lens_comment
entrypoints.description: Compose GitHub PR markdown comment enclosing standalone diagram and progressive walkthrough

parameters.name: svg_content
parameters.description: Rendered SVG string to embed in comment
